findings.current: the bridge between the two worlds would remain broken
findings.defect: “Remain broken” implies the bridge had already been broken. The source says the bridge connecting the two worlds will not be connected until the Quest is cleared.
findings.rationale: The Korean describes whether the bridge is connected before the Quest is cleared, not a prior breakage.
findings.replacement: the bridge between the two worlds would not be connected

summary: Mostly faithful. Two minor wording choices introduce implications not established by the Korean.
